reason: Appendix E critical-exponent and suppression fits need the source p-grid and at least 25 failures per plotted point. The low-p wing of this run does not supply those failures, so the fit was not performed.
cost_estimate: The missing ingredient is failures, not CPU time: toric L=5 at p=.10 already used 10,000 trials and produced 1 failure.
decision: No Appendix E fit was computed.
justification: Fitting a slope to points the source rule would discard would not be the reported procedure.
